text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants holding valid foreign passports and in good health, with a high school degree or above. 2. Be aged over 16, those who are under 18 before August 31 of the application year, please visit Downloadto download and submit GUARANTEE STATEMENT. 3. Comply with the regulations （JW〔2020〕No. 12） issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. Applicants should meet the following language requirements Chinese-taught Programs: minimum requirements of HSK 4（190 or above for science and engineering majors, 210 or above for humanities and business majors, 60 or above in writing）. Those who've been granted previous degrees from Chinese-taught programs are exempted from HSK requirements. 5. CSCA Test Subjects download here .
